description: Hello! I am Rizwana Nawab participating solo from Khushab, Punjab, Pakistan in Universal Event. I am passionate about Space Exploration and Storytelling. I chose the challenge 'Abandoned but not Forgotten'. I am working solo and excited to create a project about NASA's equipment left on Moon and Mars.
summary:
Our project tells the story of NASA's abandoned hardware in a simple, fun way for school children.

Since the 1960s, NASA left rovers, landers, flags, cameras and probes on the Moon, on Mars and in deep space. Our project has 3 chapters: Moon, Mars and Deep Space.

Moon: Apollo missions, Moon rovers, flags and footprints.
Mars: Curiosity, Perseverance and Ingenuity helicopter.
Deep Space: Voyager 1 and Voyager 2 with Golden Record.

We use storytelling so children feel curiosity and love for science. This project is made for students in small towns of Pakistan like Khushab, who have less access to science labs. Our goal is that every child should know that even abandoned things in space have a great story and great science behind them.
details:
Yes, we used Super Intelligence (Meta AI) as a helper for our project.

We used it to organize our story into 3 chapters (Moon, Mars, Deep Space), to write simple English for school children, and to get ideas for design and presentation in Canva.

The story idea, research about NASA missions, and final design decisions are our own. AI only helped us to write clearly and to present our ideas in a better way.
